mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) as of the most recent month is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns, reflecting the market's anticipation of accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% in the most recent month, it signals economic weakness and leads to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in periods with UNRATE > 4.5 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0 signals a weakening economy, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in INDPRO < 100 AND UNRATE > 4.0 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE <= 4.0 and INDPRO > 105), a housing starts level below 1400 (HOUST < 1400) signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in late-cycle expansion with HOUST < 1400 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) as of the most recent month is associated with positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns, reflecting strong consumer and business demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in high CPIAUCSL periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400 and a decline in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below 505000 signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in HOUST < 1400 AND RSAFS < 505000 periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a potential economic slowdown, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day returns in supply contraction periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
